turns.question: Which channel's cost per booking rose the most from the week of 14 September 2026 to the week of 21 September, and by how many euros?
turns.answer: Social's cost per booking (EUR) rose the most, from €98.00 in the week of 14 September 2026 (14-20 Sep) to €125.00 in the week of 21 September (21-27 Sep), a rise of €27.00 per booking (search fell from €117.50 to €114.38, email stayed at €70.00, and display and partner had no figures for those weeks).
